mappings.note: Both verses contain the superscription about David and Abimelek.
Content matches: Praising the Lord at all times.
Content matches: Soul glorifying in the Lord and the humble hearing/joying.
Content matches: Magnify the Lord together.
Content matches: Sought the Lord and was delivered from fears.
Content matches: Look to Him and be radiant; faces not ashamed.
Content matches: The poor cried out and was saved from troubles.
Content matches: Angel encamps around those who fear Him.
Content matches: Taste and see the Lord is good; blessed is he who takes refuge.
Content matches: Fear the Lord, His holy ones lack nothing.
Content matches: Lions suffer hunger but seekers of God do not lack good things.
Content matches: Come children, hear me; I will teach fear of the Lord.
Content matches: Who desires life and loves to see good days?
Content matches: Keep tongue from evil and lips from deceit.
Content matches: Turn from evil, do good; seek peace and pursue it.
Content matches: Lord's eyes on the righteous, ears to their cry for help.
Content matches: Lord's face against evildoers to cut off memory from earth.
Content matches: They cried out and were delivered from troubles (plural).
Content matches: Lord near to brokenhearted; saves crushed in spirit.
Content matches: Many troubles of the righteous, but Lord delivers from all.
Content matches: He guards bones; not one shall be broken.
Translation verse contains only the first half of OSMAIN v22 ('Evil kills the wicked...'). The second part is in translation v23.
Translation verse contains only the second half of OSMAIN v22 ('The Lord redeems...'). This text is missing from a separate translation verse in OSMAIN.
